criteria.text: Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Whitlock Technologies Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($4,800,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Kestrel Industries Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $1,600,000 and the Seller's $2,200,000.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
